text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this photo is... from the very first 
Christmas party we spent together as the 
full student council.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Under your leadership, President, it 
was a massive success.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Even though you insisted strongly on 
dressing up as the tree... I had 
recommended a Santa outfit instead, but...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It suited me well, didn't it? I'm 
*tree-mendously* proud of that Christmas 
tree... Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...*Ahem*. And next, this one—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Vodka and Daiwa Scarlet... was it? That 
was a tremendous success as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Air Groove, good work. I saw the photo.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Also, the event broadcast... I apologize 
for leaving it all in your hands.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ............ So, how did you find it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it was wonderful. Seeing everyone 
look so happy—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: No... I am asking about you, President.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The symbol of happiness that "we" built 
together— I am asking how that light 
appeared in your eyes.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, it was beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I truly thought it was beautiful. That 
blissful illumination you all showed me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: What a roundabout way of doing things.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Well, good for you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I'm here. ...What's with the silence 
between you two?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...A photo album. Reminiscing about the 
past again?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Something like that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now then, shall we begin?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Uniting our hearts and efforts— Let our 
student council activities commence once 
again today!

Another day at Tracen Academy. Today as 
well, the members of the student council 
run at full speed for the sake of the 
students' dreams...!
